origin.description: Encode an object, gzip it, and return base64.
origin.details: Base64 makes the gzip payload safe for a text field.

translation.details: The compared value is the JSON after base64 decode and gunzip.
translation.example:
import gzip
from jsonlite import as_gzjson_b64, base64_dec
print(gzip.decompress(base64_dec(as_gzjson_b64({"a": 1}))).decode())
